description: This PHP class 'LicenceAcceptanceController' resides within the 'Installer' module of the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract controller and manages the license acceptance screen during installation. The class primarily sets up a Vue component for the license acceptance UI and updates the installation state.

classes.name: LicenceAcceptanceController
classes.description: Controller managing the license acceptance step during installation, sets up the license acceptance Vue component and updates installation state.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the license acceptance screen by creating and setting the Vue component, and updating the current installation screen state.
